name: monofett
description: Monofett started as designs for custom mountain bike branding. As a font it is designed to be a bold, eye catching decal-like display face with a sense of an edgy but technical function. In 2023 the font have been updated, offering a better language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/monofett .
